subject: Re: Fee timing and Exhibit recast — Stellarus order form
messages:
From: Sophie Park <sophie.park@stellarus.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@stellarus.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Shift fee recognition & exhibit recast for pilot scale-up

Hi Ava,

Quick note from our side — the pilot we went live with last month is scaling faster than expected. We need to accelerate the additional throughput from Q4 to mid-September and move the implementation fee to a pro-rated monthly schedule rather than a single upfront invoice.

Can you send a proposed change order that:
- Reallocates 300k tokens to the mid-September start date
- Converts the one-time implementation fee of $45k into a three-month amortized charge starting on signing
- Updates Exhibit B to reflect the revised SOW paragraph about the training window

If you can draft something by Tuesday that we can run by procurement/legal, that would help keep the pilot healthy.

Thanks,
Sophie Park
Head of ML Ops, Stellarus Health
S: +1 415 555 0142

Attachments: none

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie.park@stellarus.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Shift fee recognition & exhibit recast for pilot scale-up

Hi Sophie — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the strong pilot numbers.

I attached a first-pass change order that:
- Moves 300k tokens with an effective date of 2026-09-15
- Breaks the $45k implementation fee into three monthly installments (30/30/40 split on the attached spreadsheet to match your ramp)
- Proposes revised Exhibit B language for the training window and deliverables

High level asks from our side: confirmation of the exact billing contact and whether you want the monthly installments invoiced to the original PO or a new billing account. Karthik — can you confirm approval path and preferred DocuSign flow?

I will loop Legal on a formal redline; attaching the draft now to keep momentum.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 650 555 0198

Attachments: stellarus_co_changeorder_draft_v1.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: Shift fee recognition & exhibit recast for pilot scale-up

Ava / Karthik — I reviewed Sophie's note and your change order draft. I made inline redlines and a short summary (see redline_highlights.pdf). Key Legal items: 

1) Billing trigger: changing the implementation fee to monthly is acceptable, but we need a clause that ties the first installment to the execution date and the subsequent installments to invoice schedule (net 30). I added wording to Section 2.1.

2) Liability carveouts: the revised Exhibit B contains a new clause about a training window. I tightened the acceptance criteria language to avoid open-ended deliverables. Please confirm if Stellarus expects acceptance signoff or simple time-based acceptance.

3) Audit & logs: procurement asked if the expanded throughput requires any changes to our audit logging retention — I inserted a reference to the existing DPA and flagged it for product to confirm technical feasibility.

Karthik — I've left two comments where we might consider a smallone-time implementation credit if they commit to an additional 12-month minimum after the ramp. That could be a negotiation lever.

Next steps: Ava, send the redlined doc to Sophie and ask for procurement's position on acceptance and billing account. I can prepare a clean change order post-comments.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_highlights.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie.park@stellarus.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Shift fee recognition & exhibit recast for pilot scale-up

Hi Sophie — looping in procurement/accounting on our side to speed approvals. A few quick items: 

- Billing contact: please confirm whether invoices should go to invoices@stellarus.com or procurement@stellarus.com.
- Acceptance: given your timeline, time-based acceptance (30 days after training completion) is simplest, but if you want a signoff we can include a lightweight acceptance form. Which do you prefer?
- Incentive: we can offer a $5k implementation credit if you commit to a 12-month term extension starting 2026-10-01. Marissa has redlined optional language for that.

If procurement confirms billing address by midday PST, I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and route it to your legal and procurement teams.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Vendor Lead, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 212 555 0123

Attachments: none

Thanks everyone — good progress. A few answers from procurement/legal: 

- Invoices should go to procurement@stellarus.com.
- We prefer time-based acceptance: 30 days after the training window ends. Please keep acceptance criteria as Marissa's tightened language.
- The $5k implementation credit is acceptable if we sign the 12-month extension. We are prepared to sign once the redline on the liability language is clarified (Tom will follow with a single suggested sentence).

Please send a DocuSign package for countersignature. Tom — I'll share the procurement PO number after the envelope is ready.
